tools_pieni.description: Type one line at the CADCraft command line, exactly as a user would at an AutoCAD-style prompt. Starts commands by name or alias (LINE, L, CIRCLE, C, PLINE, RECTANG, MOVE, TRIM, OFFSET, ZOOM…) and answers the active prompt: points `x,y`, relative `@dx,dy`, polar `@dist<angle`, distances, keywords (e.g. `c` for Close), empty text = Enter. Spaces act as Enter, so `circle 0,0 5` works in one call. Returns the new prompt and command-line output, and `error` when the line was refused.
tools_pieni.name: command_line

tools_pieni.description: Run a multi-line script (like an AutoCAD .scr file): one or more inputs per line, blank line = Enter.
tools_pieni.name: script

tools_pieni.description: Run any command with JSON parameters (no prompts or dialogs). Use list_commands to find ids and parameter docs. Examples: line {points:[[0,0],[10,0]]}, circle {center:[0,0], radius:5}, layer.new {name:"Walls", color:"red", current:true}, move {handles:["10A"], delta:[5,0]}, zoom {mode:"extents"}.
tools_pieni.name: execute

tools_pieni.description: List commands with ids, labels, menu paths, aliases and parameter docs. Optional filter: a substring of the command id, label or an alias.
tools_pieni.name: list_commands

tools_pieni.description: Summary of the active drawing: entity counts, extents, layers, styles, blocks, layouts, selection, undo history and (optionally) entities with handles and geometry.
tools_pieni.name: inspect_drawing

tools_pieni.description: Entities filtered by type (Line, Circle, Polyline…), layer, current selection (selected:true; active space only) and/or a window [[x0,y0],[x1,y1]] (objects whose geometry is inside or crosses it; crossing:false = entirely inside). Returns count (all matches), returned (this page) and entities; page with offset and limit (default 500).
tools_pieni.name: query_entities

tools_pieni.description: Render the active drawing to a PNG and return it as an image: fitted to the extents by default, or just the area `window` [[x0,y0],[x1,y1]] (drawing units), e.g. one sheet or one room of a large drawing. With a window and no size the image is 1600 px wide with the window's shape.
tools_pieni.name: render

tools_pieni.description: Read the drawing's texts: TEXT, MTEXT (formatting removed), block attributes and multileaders, each with its text, insertion point `at`, height, rotation, style, layer and handle. Filter by `contains` (any case), `layer` and/or `window` [[x0,y0],[x1,y1]] around the insertion points; page with offset and limit (default 200). Use it to find room names, sheet titles and notes without reading all the geometry.
tools_pieni.name: find_text

tools_pieni.description: Create a new drawing (imperial by default, or metric).
tools_pieni.name: new_drawing

tools_pieni.description: Open a DXF file.
tools_pieni.name: open

tools_pieni.description: Save the drawing (DXF or DWG by extension). A .svg, .png or .pdf path exports instead: the drawing keeps its name and unsaved changes.
tools_pieni.name: save

tools_pieni.description: Press Escape: cancel the running command (or clear the selection).
tools_pieni.name: cancel

tools_pieni.description: List DesignCraft commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, parameter description and whether it can run right now. Every user-visible action is a command (frame.create, text.insert, type.char, style.paragraph.apply, layout.pages.insert, object.fill, transform.move, edit.undo…); run them with execute or batch.

enabledOnly.description: Only commands that can run right now

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against id, label and menu path (e.g. "frame", "style", "Layout")

tools_pieni.name: list_commands
tools_pieni.title: List commands

tools_pieni.description: Run any DesignCraft command by id with JSON params (ids and params from list_commands). Examples: {"command":"frame.create","params":{"rect":[36,36,576,300],"content":"text","text":"Hello"}} → {id, story}; {"command":"type.char","params":{"size":24}}; {"command":"edit.undo"}. Coordinates are points in spread space. In the desktop app the UI-only commands (view.*, window.*, help.*, edit.dynamicSpelling, and app.* except app.links, which works everywhere) work too.

params.description: Command parameters (see the `params` field of list_commands)

tools_pieni.name: execute
tools_pieni.title: Execute command

tools_pieni.description: Run several commands in order, stopping at the first error. Returns each result; on failure also the failing index and message (earlier commands stay applied; use edit.undo to revert them). Later steps can use earlier results: a parameter string "$N.path" is replaced by that value of step N's result (0-based; "$last.path" for the previous step), e.g. after frame.create → {"id": 8, "story": 9}, {"story": "$0.story"} passes 9; "${N.path}" interpolates into longer strings. Other strings starting with $ stay as written; "$$" is a literal $ ("$$1" passes the GREP group $1). Give `commands`, or `script` text (one `command.id {json}` per line).

params.description: Command parameters (see the `params` field of list_commands)

script.description: Alternative to `commands`: lines of `command.id {json params}` (# comments allowed)

tools_pieni.name: batch
tools_pieni.title: Execute commands

tools_pieni.description: Summary of the active document: settings, pages (index, name, bounds, margins, columns), spreads with items (id, kind, bounds, fill, stroke, story), stories (id, frames, length in UTF-8 bytes, overset, preview), layers, paragraph/character styles, swatches, selection, active tool.

tools_pieni.description: Input method (IME) events at the Type tool's caret, as a system IME sends them: `preedit` is the marked text (shown in place, no undo step; an empty string cancels the composition), `active` the clause being converted in characters of it, `commit` the text the IME types in its place (one undo step). Example, Japanese: {preedit:"にほん", active:[3,3]} then {preedit:"日本", active:[0,2]} then {commit:"日本"}. Returns whether a composition is still open.

tools_pieni.description: List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, `params` doc (e.g. `{name?, width?, height?, frameRate?, duration? (s)}`) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Every menu item, shortcut and panel gesture maps to one of these ids; run them with execute_command. Narrow with `filter` (e.g. `layer.new`, `keys`, `effect`).

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

schemas.description: Also return each command's parameter JSON Schema (`schema`).

tools_pieni.name: list_commands
tools_pieni.title: List commands

tools_pieni.description: One command in full: id, label, menu path, shortcut, the `params` doc, a JSON Schema of its parameters (`schema`: properties, required, additionalProperties) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Use before execute_command when unsure of the parameters; execute_command rejects unknown keys.
tools_pieni.name: describe_command
tools_pieni.title: Describe command

tools_pieni.description: Run any engine command by id with JSON params; edits are undoable. Examples: comp.new {"name":"Main","width":1920,"height":1080,"frameRate":30,"duration":5}; layer.newText {"text":"Hello","size":120,"fill":"#ffffff"} (returns {"layer":id}); layer.newSolid {"color":"#3366ff"}; layer.newShape; effect.apply {"layer":3,"effect":"Gaussian Blur"}; time.set {"time":2.5}; layer.select {"layers":[3]}. Layers are referenced by id, "#n" or name; times are seconds.

params.description: Command parameters as documented by list_commands.

tools_pieni.name: execute_command
tools_pieni.title: Execute command

tools_pieni.description: Run JavaScript with an After Effects-style scripting object model (app, app.project, items.addComp, comp.layers.addSolid/addText/addShape/addNull/addCamera/addLight, layer.property("ADBE Transform Group").property("ADBE Position").setValueAtTime(t, v), Effects.addProperty("ADBE Gaussian Blur 2"), expressions, markers, renderQueue…). Every edit is an undoable engine command; app.beginUndoGroup/endUndoGroup make one undo step. Returns {ok, result (last expression value), output (writeLn/$.writeln/alert text), error: {message, line, column} | null}. File access is limited to the project folder unless the user allows scripts to write files.

code.description: JavaScript source, e.g. `var c = app.project.items.addComp("Main", 1920, 1080, 1, 5, 30); c.layers.addText("Hi"); c.numLayers`.

name.description: Script name used in error messages (default `script`).

tools_pieni.name: run_script
tools_pieni.title: Run script

tools_pieni.description: Project overview: file path, dirty flag, bit depth, every item (id, name, type Composition/Footage/Solid/Folder, size, duration, layer count), the active comp id, current time (s), selected layers and the undo stack.
tools_pieni.name: get_project
tools_pieni.title: Get project

tools_pieni.description: A composition: id, name, size, frame rate, duration, work area, background and its layers top to bottom (id, index, name, type, in/out/start seconds, blend mode, parent, track matte, switches). Layer ids feed get_layer, get_property/set_property and commands.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

tools_pieni.name: get_comp
tools_pieni.title: Get comp

tools_pieni.description: A layer's property tree (transform, masks, effects, text, shape contents, ...): leaf properties have a `path` usable with get_property/set_property/add_keyframe, plus uid, match id, name, type, value at `time`, keyframes and expression. Groups contain children; inspect them here, then select a leaf path. `flat: true` returns just a list of {path, type, value, keys, expression} (compact).

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

flat.description: Return a flat list of properties instead of the tree.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

time.description: Comp time in seconds for values (default: current time).

tools_pieni.name: get_layer
tools_pieni.title: Get layer

tools_pieni.description: Read one property: type, value at `time` (comp seconds; default the current time), whether it is animated, its keyframes (time, value, in/out interpolation) and expression.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

tools_pieni.name: get_property
tools_pieni.title: Get property

tools_pieni.description: Set a property. Without `time`: sets the static value (or a key at the current time if already animated). With `time`: adds/replaces a keyframe there, turning the stopwatch on. `expression` sets an After Effects-style JS expression ("" removes it). Returns the property as get_property does. Examples: {"layer":3,"path":"transform/opacity","value":50}; {"layer":"Title","path":"transform/position","value":[200,540],"time":0}; {"layer":3,"path":"transform/rotation","expression":"time*90"}.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

expression.description: Expression text; empty string removes the expression.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

time.description: Keyframe time in seconds (layer time; equals comp time unless the layer is offset/stretched).

timeBase.description: What `time` counts: layer time (the default) or comp time, as the Timeline shows it.

value.description: Number for 1-D properties (50), array for vectors ([960,540]), "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a] (0-1) for colours, bool for checkboxes, string for text/menus.

tools_pieni.name: set_property
tools_pieni.title: Set property

tools_pieni.description: Add keyframes to a property (turns the stopwatch on): one with `time` (+ optional `value`, default the current value) or many with `keys: [{time, value}]`, then optionally set their `interpolation`: linear, bezier, hold, easyEase, easyEaseIn, easyEaseOut. Example: {"layer":1,"path":"transform/position","keys":[{"time":0,"value":[0,540]},{"time":2,"value":[1920,540]}],"interpolation":"easyEase"}.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

value.description: Number for 1-D properties (50), array for vectors ([960,540]), "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a] (0-1) for colours, bool for checkboxes, string for text/menus.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

timeBase.description: What `time` counts: layer time (the default) or comp time, as the Timeline shows it.

value.description: Number for 1-D properties (50), array for vectors ([960,540]), "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a] (0-1) for colours, bool for checkboxes, string for text/menus.

tools_pieni.name: add_keyframe
tools_pieni.title: Add keyframe

tools_pieni.description: Apply an effect to a layer and optionally set its parameters in one undoable call. `effect` is an id (`ec.blur.gaussian`) or After Effects name (`Gaussian Blur`; see list_effects); `values` maps parameter ids to values, e.g. {"blurriness": 12}. One undo step; if a value fails, nothing is applied. Returns the instance `path` (`effects/#n`, for set_property / add_keyframe) and its parameters with their paths and current values.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

effect.description: Effect id or name, e.g. `Gaussian Blur`, `Glow`, `Curves`, `ec.color.levels`.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

values.description: Parameter id -> value (ids are in the returned `params` paths), e.g. {"blurriness": 12}.

tools_pieni.description: The font families text layers can use, bundled and installed on this machine: family, styles, origin (bundled / system / user), whether it is a variable font and the name in the font's own language. tools_pieni.description: Render a composition frame (default: the active comp at the current time) and return it as a PNG image, longest side `max_side` (default 960, 0 = full size). `path` also writes the PNG to disk; `inline: false` returns only the metadata. Use it to check your work.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

inline.description: Include the image in the reply (default true).

max_side.description: Longest side in pixels (default 960; 0 = full comp size).

path.description: Also write the PNG here.

time.description: Comp time in seconds (default: current time).

transparent.description: Keep the frame's alpha (RGBA PNG, as an RGB + Alpha render writes it) instead of compositing over the comp's background colour.

tools_pieni.name: render_frame
tools_pieni.title: Render frame

tools_pieni.description: Open a project: `path` to an .ecproj file, `demo: true` for the built-in demo project, or `new: true` for an empty project. Returns the project overview.

path.description: Path of an .ecproj file.

tools_pieni.name: open_project
tools_pieni.title: Open project

tools_pieni.description: Save the project to its current file, or to `path` (Save As, .ecproj).

path.description: Destination .ecproj path (Save As).

tools_pieni.name: save_project
tools_pieni.title: Save project

tools_pieni.description: Undo the last `steps` edits (default 1). Returns the remaining undo stack.
tools_pieni.name: undo
tools_pieni.title: Undo

tools_pieni.description: Redo `steps` undone edits (default 1).
tools_pieni.name: redo
tools_pieni.title: Redo

tools_pieni.description: The branching undo history (History panel): without arguments lists every state {index, id, label, parent, depth (0 = working line, >0 = branch), current, future}; undoing and then editing keeps the undone states as a branch. With `goto` (an index or id from the listing) jumps to that state, on any branch, without losing the others.

goto.description: State index or id to jump to (edit.history.goto).

tools_pieni.name: history
tools_pieni.title: History

tools_pieni.description: Drive ScriptUI windows that scripts opened (dialogs, palettes, dockable panels). action `list` (default): open windows; `get`: a window's control tree (type, name, text, value, checked, items, selection, bounds); `click`: press a button / toggle a checkbox / pick a radio button; `set`: type text, move a slider, pick a list item (index or text); `close`: close a window (`result` for a dialog's show(), default 2 = Cancel). Controls by id, "#id", properties.name or text. A dialog's script resumes when the dialog closes.

result.description: For `close`: what the dialog's show() returns.

value.description: For `set`: text, number, bool, item index or item text.

window.description: Window id or title (optional when one is open).

tools_pieni.name: script_ui
tools_pieni.title: Script ui

tools_pieni.description: Run several engine commands in one call as ONE undo step (engine.batch). Later steps can use earlier results: a string param "$N" or "$N.key" is step N's result (1-based), e.g. create a layer, then key and style it: {"steps":[{"command":"layer.newText","params":{"text":"Hi","name":"Title"}},{"command":"prop.addKey","params":{"layer":"$1.layer","path":"transform/opacity","time":0,"value":0}},{"command":"effect.apply","params":{"layer":"$1.layer","effect":"Glow"}}]}. Returns {steps, results}. If a step fails the whole batch is rolled back (unless atomic: false) and the error names the step.

atomic.description: Roll everything back when a step fails (default true).

tools_pieni.name: batch
tools_pieni.title: Batch

tools_pieni.description: List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, `params` doc (e.g. `{name?, width?, height?, frameRate?, duration? (s)}`) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Every menu item, shortcut and panel gesture maps to one of these ids; run them with execute_command. Narrow with `filter` (e.g. `layer.new`, `keys`, `effect`).

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

schemas.description: Also return each command's parameter JSON Schema (`schema`).

tools_pieni.name: command_list
tools_pieni.title: Command list

tools_pieni.description: Run any engine command by id with JSON params; edits are undoable. Examples: comp.new {"name":"Main","width":1920,"height":1080,"frameRate":30,"duration":5}; layer.newText {"text":"Hello","size":120,"fill":"#ffffff"} (returns {"layer":id}); layer.newSolid {"color":"#3366ff"}; layer.newShape; effect.apply {"layer":3,"effect":"Gaussian Blur"}; time.set {"time":2.5}; layer.select {"layers":[3]}. Layers are referenced by id, "#n" or name; times are seconds.

params.description: Command parameters as documented by list_commands.

tools_pieni.name: command_run
tools_pieni.title: Command run

tools_pieni.description: Render a composition frame (default: the active comp at the current time) and return it as a PNG image, longest side `max_side` (default 960, 0 = full size). Use it to check your work.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

max_side.description: Longest side in pixels (default 960; 0 = full comp size).

time.description: Comp time in seconds (default: current time).

transparent.description: Keep the frame's alpha (RGBA PNG, as an RGB + Alpha render writes it) instead of compositing over the comp's background colour.

tools_pieni.name: render_preview
tools_pieni.title: Render preview

tools_pieni.description: Run commands in order, returning each result or error. Stop at the first error by default; stop_on_error: false continues. Each edit has its own undo step; use batch for an atomic undo group.
tools_pieni.name: command_batch
tools_pieni.title: Command batch

tools_pieni.description: Inspect the project overview and active composition (null when no composition is active).
tools_pieni.name: doc_inspect
tools_pieni.title: Doc inspect

tools_pieni.description: List FigCraft commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, whether it is undoable, and a parameter description. Every menu item, panel action and shortcut is a command; run one with run_command (or several as one undo step with batch). Most commands act on `ids` when given, else on the selection. Use `filter` to narrow (e.g. "align", "layout", "variable", "style", "component", "proto").

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against id, label, menu path and parameter docs

tools_pieni.name: list_commands
tools_pieni.title: List commands

tools_pieni.description: Execute one FigCraft command by id with JSON params (ids and params from list_commands). Mutating commands are one undo step each; a failing command leaves the document unchanged. Examples: {"command":"align.left","params":{"ids":[3,4]}}, {"command":"layout.add","params":{"ids":[2],"direction":"vertical"}}, {"command":"style.create","params":{"type":"paint","name":"Brand/Primary","from":5}}. Returns the command's result (creation commands return {"id"}). Programmatic calls never open dialogs.

command.description: Command id, e.g. node.create, align.left, component.create, file.export

tools_pieni.name: run_command
tools_pieni.title: Run command

tools_pieni.description: Run several commands in order as ONE undo step (engine `command.batch`). If any command fails, everything is rolled back and the error names the failing step. Returns an array of the results in order. A later step can use a layer an earlier step created: anywhere in its params, {"$step": n} stands for the `id` in step n's result (zero-based; {"$step": n, "field": "…"} picks another field). Example: [{"command":"node.create","params":{"type":"frame"}}, {"command":"node.create","params":{"type":"text","text":"Hi","parent":{"$step":0}}}] builds a frame and a text inside it in one call.
tools_pieni.name: batch
tools_pieni.title: Run commands as one step

tools_pieni.description: Create a layer (engine `node.create`) and return its id and inspected properties. Coordinates are page units, y down; x/y are relative to the parent frame (the page when there is none, so then they are page coordinates; groups don't count). Inside an auto-layout frame the position is decided by the layout. The new layer becomes the selection.

height.description: Height (default 100; ignored for lines/arrows and auto-height text)

index.description: Z-index among the parent's children (default: on top)

parent.description: Parent frame/group/component id (default: the current page)

path.description: SVG path data, for type vector (e.g. "M0 0 L100 0 L50 80 Z")

props.description: Any set_properties keys applied at creation, e.g. {"fill":"#3366FF","cornerRadius":12,"fontSize":24,"layout":"vertical","gap":8,"padding":16}

width.description: Width (default 100; text hugs its content unless width is set, which makes it wrap; for a vector with path, width/height scale the path, one alone keeping its proportion, and without them the path's own box is used)

x.description: Left, relative to the parent frame (default 0)

y.description: Top, relative to the parent frame (default 0)

tools_pieni.name: create_node
tools_pieni.title: Create layer

tools_pieni.description: Set properties on one or more layers as one undo step (engine `node.set`). Keys: name, visible, locked, opacity (0-1), blend, x, y (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width, height, rotation (degrees), fill (colour) / fills (array of paints: "#hex" or {"type":"solid","color":"#hex"} or {"type":"linearGradient","stops":["#hex","#hex"]} or stops [{"position":0..1,"color":"#hex"}], optional from/to handles in the unit box; radialGradient too), stroke / strokes, strokeWeight, strokeAlign (inside|center|outside), cornerRadius (n or [tl,tr,br,bl]), effects (array, e.g. {"type":"dropShadow","color":"#00000040","offset":[0,4],"radius":8}), clip, layout (null|horizontal|vertical|grid), gap, padding (n or [t,r,b,l]), mainAlign (min|center|max|spaceBetween|spaceAround|spaceEvenly), crossAlign, wrap, contentAlign (auto|spaceBetween: wrapped lines), sizingH / sizingV (fixed|hug|fill), constraints {horizontal, vertical}, characters, fontFamily, fontStyle, fontSize, lineHeight, letterSpacing, textAlign, textAutoResize. Auto layout keys (gap, padding, mainAlign, crossAlign, wrap, …) apply to frames, components and instances only: other layers among the ids are skipped and named in `warnings`, and with none that can take them the call is an error. A fontStyle draws in the family's nearest face; `warnings` says when that face has another weight or slant than the name asks for. Run list_commands with filter "node.set" for the full list. Unknown keys are an error. Returns the updated layers.
tools_pieni.name: set_properties
tools_pieni.title: Set properties

tools_pieni.description: The active document as JSON: name, path, dirty flag, current page, selection, the current page's layer tree (id, name, type, x/y relative to the parent frame (groups don't count), width, height, absoluteBounds in page coordinates, fills, strokes, effects, cornerRadius, layout, sizing, text properties, component links, overrides, bound variables), other pages summarised, styles, variable count and the undo history. Use it to verify every change.

allPages.description: Expand every page, not only the current one

depth.description: Tree depth for the current page (default 4)

tools_pieni.name: inspect_document
tools_pieni.title: Inspect document

tools_pieni.description: One layer as JSON (same fields as inspect_document) with its children to `depth`.
tools_pieni.name: get_node
tools_pieni.title: Get layer

tools_pieni.description: Replace the selection with `ids` (switching to their page). An empty array deselects everything. Most commands act on the selection when no `ids` are passed.
tools_pieni.name: select
tools_pieni.title: Select layers

tools_pieni.description: Export layers (default: the selection, else every top-level layer of the current page) as png, jpg, svg, webp or pdf at `scale`, or the whole file as `fig` (experimental: written from public format knowledge, with `warnings` for what was left out; other apps may not open every file) (PDF: with `bleed`, `cropMarks`, `bleedMarks` and `cmyk` for print; options `contentsOnly`, `includeBoundingBox`, and for SVG `svgOutlineText`, `svgIdAttribute`, `svgSimplifyStroke`). With `path` the file is written there (absolute path recommended) and the result says where. Without `path`: png/jpg/webp come back as an image content block, svg as text, other formats as base64 `data`.

bleed.description: PDF: bleed around each page, in points or as a length like `3mm` or `0.125in`

cmyk.description: PDF: CMYK colour instead of RGB

contentsOnly.description: Only the layers themselves (default true); false also draws every other layer that shows in their area

format.description: Format (default png, or from the path's extension)

ids.description: Layers to export (several are composited into one image)

includeBoundingBox.description: Export the layers' own boxes, cutting off shadows and outside strokes (default false)

path.description: Output file path

scale.description: Pixel scale for raster formats (default 1, max 64)

size.description: Instead of `scale`: `2x`, or a width or height in pixels like `512w` / `512h`

svgIdAttribute.description: SVG: layer names as unique `id` attributes (default false)

svgOutlineText.description: SVG: text as outlines (default true); false keeps `<text>` elements

svgSimplifyStroke.description: SVG: strokes as `stroke` attributes where exact (default true); false writes outlines

tools_pieni.name: export
tools_pieni.title: Export

tools_pieni.description: Look at the design: renders the given layers (or the whole current page, with its background) to PNG and returns it as image content, plus its size and the scale used. The image is scaled down to fit `maxSize` pixels. With `window: true` (or a window id from `inspect_ui`'s `windows`) and an attached app, captures that app window including the UI instead.

ids.description: Layers to render (default: the whole current page)

scale.description: Requested scale (default 1; reduced to fit maxSize)

window.description: Capture the app window: true for the one in front, or a window id (attached app only; headless renders the page)

tools_pieni.name: screenshot
tools_pieni.title: Screenshot

tools_pieni.description: Open a .figcraft or .json document (FigCraft or REST API file JSON), a .fig file (best effort, with `warnings` for what wasn't imported), an .svg (becomes vectors) or an image (becomes an image layer) as the active document. Returns the new document's summary.

path.description: File path

variables.description: REST API file JSON only: the local variables JSON (`GET /v1/files/:key/variables/local`) as a path or the JSON object. Default: `<name>.variables.json` or `variables.json` next to the file.

tools_pieni.name: open_file
tools_pieni.title: Open file

tools_pieni.description: Save the active document as a .figcraft file. `path` is required the first time (an untitled document has no path); later saves reuse it. A `path` ending in .fig writes an experimental .fig export copy instead and leaves the document's own path and unsaved changes alone.

path.description: Output .figcraft path, or a .fig path for an experimental export copy

tools_pieni.name: save_file
tools_pieni.title: Save file

tools_pieni.description: Undo the last change (one command, batch or gesture). Returns {undone: bool}.
tools_pieni.name: undo
tools_pieni.title: Undo

tools_pieni.description: Redo the last undone change. Returns {redone: bool}.
tools_pieni.name: redo
tools_pieni.title: Redo

tools_pieni.description: Drive the canvas with the mouse in page coordinates, exactly as a user would with the current tool: click to select, drag to move/resize/marquee, or draw with a shape tool (set `tool` first, e.g. {"tool":"rectangle","kind":"drag","x":0,"y":0,"to":[200,100]}). `double` on a text layer starts editing it. Returns the selection and tool.

pressure.description: Pen pressure 0-1 (the Pencil records it as the stroke's width profile; a drag starts with it)

pressureTo.description: Pen pressure 0-1 at a drag's end (interpolated along it)

tools_pieni.name: pointer
tools_pieni.title: Pointer gesture

tools_pieni.description: Press a key or shortcut as if typed on the canvas: a menu shortcut (e.g. {"key":"G","cmd":true} groups, {"key":"A","alt":true,"shift":false} …), a tool key (R, O, T, F, V…), Escape, Delete, Enter, arrows (nudge; shift = big nudge). While editing text, keys go to the text editor (Backspace, Delete, Left, Right, Home, End, Enter, Escape, SelectAll).

key.description: Key name: a letter/digit, Escape, Delete, Backspace, Enter, ArrowLeft…

tools_pieni.name: key
tools_pieni.title: Press key

tools_pieni.description: Type into a text layer. With `id`, starts editing that layer with all of its text selected (so the typed text replaces it), types, then stops editing. Without `id`, types at the caret of the text currently being edited (after a double-click with pointer, or after drawing with the text tool).

id.description: Text layer to replace the contents of

text.description: Text to type (\n for a new line)

tools_pieni.name: type_text
tools_pieni.title: Type text

tools_pieni.description: UI state: current tool, view (zoom, centre), status, panels, timings and the app's windows (`windows`: id, title, files) when attached to the app; headless reports the session status.
tools_pieni.name: inspect_ui
tools_pieni.title: Inspect UI

tools_pieni.name: command_batch
tools_pieni.title: Run several commands
tools_pieni.description: Run several commands in order: {steps: [{id, params?}], stop_on_error?: true}. Returns {completed, failed, results: [{ok, result | error}]}; each edit is its own undo step.

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true).

tools_pieni.name: command_list
tools_pieni.title: List commands
tools_pieni.description: List every command (id, label, menu path, shortcut, parameter doc, enabled now). Menus, shortcuts, panels and timeline gestures all map to these ids.

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools_pieni.name: command_run
tools_pieni.title: Run a command
tools_pieni.description: Run a command by id with JSON params, e.g. {"id":"timeline.razor","params":{"seconds":3.5}} or {"id":"effects.apply","params":{"effect":"Gaussian Blur"}}. Undoable edits land in History.

tools_pieni.name: doc_inspect
tools_pieni.title: Inspect the document
tools_pieni.description: The project as JSON: the tree (as project_inspect) plus the active sequence (as sequence_inspect; null when there is none).

tools_pieni.name: media_import
tools_pieni.title: Import media
tools_pieni.description: Import media files by absolute path (MP4/MOV, WAV/MP3/FLAC/AIFF/Ogg, PNG/JPEG/…).

image_sequence.description: Import numbered stills as an image sequence (optional, default false).

paths.description: Absolute paths to media files (MP4/MOV, WAV/MP3/FLAC/AIFF/Ogg, PNG/JPEG/…).

tools_pieni.name: project_inspect
tools_pieni.title: Inspect the project tree
tools_pieni.description: Project tree (bins and items with ids, types, durations), active sequence, source clip.

tools_pieni.name: render_frame
tools_pieni.title: Render a frame
tools_pieni.description: Render the active sequence's frame (at `seconds` or the playhead) and return it as PNG.

seconds.description: Timeline time in seconds (default: the playhead).

tools_pieni.name: render_preview
tools_pieni.title: Render a preview
tools_pieni.description: The active sequence's frame at `seconds` (default: the playhead) as PNG, same as render_frame (bridge mode: Program monitor screenshot).

seconds.description: Timeline time in seconds (default: the playhead).

tools_pieni.name: sequence_inspect
tools_pieni.title: Inspect the active sequence
tools_pieni.description: The active sequence as JSON: settings, tracks, clips (ids, start/duration in ticks and frames, effects), transitions, markers, in/out, playhead, selection. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second.

tools_pieni.name: ui_click
tools_pieni.title: Live app: click
tools_pieni.description: Live app: click an element by id or at x,y (points). Supports right/middle button, double-click (count=2) and modifiers.

tools_pieni.name: ui_control
tools_pieni.title: Live app: control-channel call
tools_pieni.description: Live app: call any control-channel method directly (ui.set, ui.scroll, ui.timeline.hit, ui.timeline.locate, ui.playback, ui.panel.show, ui.menu.list, …).

tools_pieni.name: ui_drag
tools_pieni.title: Live app: drag
tools_pieni.description: Live app: press-drag-release from one point/element to another (move clips, trim edges, scrub, resize panels, drop project items onto tracks).

from.description: Start: {"id":..} or {"x":..,"y":..} (optionally "fx"/"fy" fractions inside the element).

tools_pieni.name: ui_elements
tools_pieni.title: Live app: on-screen elements
tools_pieni.description: Live app: every on-screen interactive element with id, label and rect (points). Use ids with ui_click/ui_drag.

prefix.description: Only element ids starting with this prefix (e.g. `timeline.clip.`).

tools_pieni.name: ui_inspect
tools_pieni.title: Live app: UI state
tools_pieni.description: Live app: UI state (tool, workspace, panels, timeline zoom, playback, selection, fps).

tools_pieni.name: ui_key
tools_pieni.title: Live app: press a key
tools_pieni.description: Live app: press a key or shortcut (e.g. `Space`, `L`, `Cmd+K`, `Shift+Delete`, `Cmd+Z`).

tools_pieni.name: ui_screenshot
tools_pieni.title: Live app: screenshot
tools_pieni.description: Live app: screenshot of the window or one panel (PNG).

panel.description: Panel to crop to (e.g. `Timeline`, `Program`); omit for the whole window.

tools_pieni.name: ui_type
tools_pieni.title: Live app: type text
tools_pieni.description: Live app: type text into the focused field.

tools_pieni.description: Run ANY GridCraft command by id with JSON params — every ribbon/menu action is a command. Find ids and parameter docs with list_commands. Examples: {"command":"cell.set","params":{"cell":"B2","input":"=SUM(A1:A9)"}}; {"command":"home.bold","params":{"range":"A1:C1"}}; {"command":"sheet.insert"}; {"command":"data.removeDuplicates","params":{"range":"A1:C20"}}. Most commands act on the current selection when `range` is omitted. Programmatic calls never open dialogs: missing required params give an error.

params.description: Command parameters (see the `params` field of list_commands); omit or {} for defaults

tools_pieni.name: execute_command
tools_pieni.title: Execute command

tools_pieni.description: List GridCraft commands: id, label, ribbon path, shortcut, a parameter description (`params`) and whether it can run right now. Use it to discover what execute_command can do (e.g. search "sort", "border", "chart", "sheet").

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against id, label and ribbon path

tools_pieni.name: list_commands
tools_pieni.title: List commands

tools_pieni.description: Summary of the active workbook: title, path, dirty flag, sheets (name, used range, cell count, tables, charts, merges, filters, freeze panes), defined names, current selection and active cell, calculation mode and undo/redo history.
tools_pieni.name: inspect_workbook
tools_pieni.title: Inspect workbook

tools_pieni.description: Read cell values from a range as rows (2-D array). Numbers/booleans/strings are returned as JSON values, empty cells as null, errors as {"error":"#DIV/0!"}. Without `range`, reads the sheet's used range. formulas:true returns formula text ("=SUM(B2:B4)") for formula cells; formatted:true returns the displayed text ("$1,234.00", "12%").

formatted.description: Return display text with number formats applied

formulas.description: Return formulas instead of computed values for formula cells

tools_pieni.name: read_range
tools_pieni.title: Read range

tools_pieni.description: Write a 2-D array of values starting at the top-left cell of `range` (rows of cells). Numbers, booleans, null (clears) and strings are accepted; strings starting with = are formulas ("=SUM(B2:B4)"), other strings are parsed like typed input ("12%", "1/2/2024", "$5"). One undo step. Example: {"range":"A1","values":[["Item","Cost"],["Rent",1200]]}.

range.description: Top-left cell or range, e.g. "A1" or "Sheet2!B3"

tools_pieni.name: write_range
tools_pieni.title: Write range

tools_pieni.description: Enter one cell exactly as if typed: a number, text, or a formula starting with = ("=AVERAGE(B2:B9)"). Dependent cells recalculate. Returns the command result; use get_cell to read the computed value.
tools_pieni.name: set_cell
tools_pieni.title: Set cell

tools_pieni.description: Details of one cell: computed value and type, formula, display text, raw input, spill range, style, merge, comment and hyperlink.
tools_pieni.name: get_cell
tools_pieni.title: Get cell

tools_pieni.description: Evaluate a formula against the active sheet WITHOUT changing any cell, e.g. "=SUM(B2:B10)/COUNT(B2:B10)" or "=VLOOKUP(\"x\",A:B,2,FALSE)". `cell` sets the formula's position for relative references and ROW()/COLUMN(). Use English function names and `,` between arguments; a formula that couldn't be entered in a cell is an error saying why.

cell.description: Evaluate as if in this cell (default: active cell)

formula.description: Formula text, with or without the leading =

tools_pieni.name: evaluate_formula
tools_pieni.title: Evaluate formula

tools_pieni.description: Set the selection (what commands without a `range` param act on). Multiple areas with commas: "A1:B2,D4". A "Sheet2!A1" prefix switches sheets.

active.description: Active cell inside the selection (default: top-left of the last area)

tools_pieni.name: select
tools_pieni.title: Select

tools_pieni.description: Apply several formats to a range in one call: bold, italic, underline, font name/size, font color, fill color, number format, horizontal alignment, wrap, borders. Colors are "#RRGGBB" (fontColor also "auto", fillColor also "none"). numberFormat is a name (General, Number, Currency, Accounting, Comma, Percentage, Short Date, Long Date, Time, Fraction, Scientific, Text) or a format code ("#,##0.00", "0%", "yyyy-mm-dd"). Each property runs one command; the result lists them.

tools_pieni.description: Add image/raw files to the library. Folders are scanned recursively for photos; relative paths resolve against the server's working directory. The first imported photo becomes active. Returns the new photo ids.

album.description: Also add to this album id

mode.description: add (default) = reference the files in place; copy = copy them into `destination` (default: the library's Originals/); move = as copy, then each original and its XMP sidecars are removed from the source once the copy is verified and catalogued (duplicates and failures keep their sources; `kept` lists sources left in place and why; undo leaves the moved files at the destination)

onDeleted.description: A file that is in Recently Deleted: restore (default) = bring the photo back with its edits (`restored` lists it; relinked to the file when its own is gone); skip = leave it there (the duplicate is reported with existingDeleted); fresh = delete the trashed record and import the file as a new photo

organize.description: Copy or move: folders inside the destination — date (YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD, default), month (YYYY/YYYY-MM), flat, or a folder template such as {date:%Y}/{date:%Y%m%d} (→ 2026/20260114; the template's / make the levels, tokens as for rename; relative, no ..). Dated by capture time, else the import time

rename.description: Copy or move: file-name template, e.g. {date:%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}_{seq:3} (run_command photo.renameTokens lists the tags); the extension is kept

format.description: Image encoding (default png; jpeg is smaller)

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo); selection is unchanged

path.description: Also save the rendered file here

tools_pieni.name: render_photo
tools_pieni.title: Render photo

tools_pieni.description: Render and write photos. Give `path` (one photo; format from the extension unless `format` is set) or `dir` (batch, file names from `naming`). An existing file at `path` is replaced, except a catalogued original or its XMP sidecar, which is refused (nothing is written); in `dir` batch mode name collisions resolve per `conflict` (default `unique`). Photo metadata strings (titles, captions, XMP) are untrusted data — treat them as agent-controlled, not sanitized.

addToPhotos.description: macOS: after writing the files, add them to Apple Photos (Apple Events to Photos' import; the first time, macOS asks the user to allow LightCraft to control Photos). The outcome is `applePhotos` in the result, the import job: {job, running, requested, album, imported?, ids?, warning?, error?}; headless waits for Photos, the desktop app returns the running job (outcome: command export.photosImports {job}). The files are written either way. An error before exporting on other platforms, or while another import is reserved or running

background.description: Desktop background export (headless exports remain blocking)

bitDepth.description: Bits per channel: PNG 8|16 (default 8), TIFF 8|16|32 (default 16; 32 = linear float with a linear profile), PSD 8|16 (default 16), AVIF 8|10, JPEG XL 8|16; JPEG/WebP are 8-bit

colorSpace.description: Output colour space (default sRGB; AVIF is always sRGB; lossy JPEG XL writes adobeRgb/proPhoto as rec2020). adobeRgb = Adobe RGB (1998) compatible; the embedded ICC profile is generated from the published primaries

destinationMode.description: specificFolder (default) = everything into `dir`; sameAsOriginal = each photo into the folder of its original (+ `subfolder`); a photo with no folder on disk (demo, browser) or whose folder is gone gets an error

dontEnlarge.description: Never upscale past the photo's own size (default true)

fit.description: With width + height: dimensions (default) fits either orientation (the larger number goes to the long edge); widthHeight limits the width to `width` and the height to `height` as the photo stands

format.description: psd = a flat PSD (no layers); rendereddng = Render to DNG, a linear 16-bit float DNG of the rendered photo with the edit baked in; original = the file as is + an XMP sidecar with the edits; dng = raw photos as DNG with the edits embedded

hdr.description: HDR output for photos edited in HDR (develop.hdr): JPEG as an ISO 21496-1 gain map JPEG, AVIF as 10-bit, PNG and JPEG XL as 16-bit Rec. 2020 PQ, 32-bit TIFF with highlights above 1; other formats and SDR edits export as usual

hdrTransfer.description: Transfer curve of HDR AVIF output (default pq): pq = SMPTE ST 2084, hlg = ITU-R BT.2100 hybrid log-gamma

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

ids.description: Photos to export (default: the given/active photo)

jxlEffort.description: JPEG XL encoder effort: normal (default) makes files about a quarter smaller than fast, in about twice the time

jxlLossless.description: JPEG XL: mathematically lossless (quality unused); default false

jxlProgressive.description: JPEG XL: progressive file, a coarse image first (default false)

limitKb.description: JPEG: largest quality that fits this many KB

longEdge.description: Output long edge in px. When no size param is given: 3000; 0 = full size (cropped, native resolution)

percent.description: Output size as a percentage of full size

photosAlbum.description: With addToPhotos: the album to add them to, a top-level Photos album of exactly this name, made when missing (several of that name: nothing is added); default none

ppi.description: Print resolution written into the file (default 240)

resize.description: Full Resize options; alternatively use the size helpers below

watermark.description: Text, or {text, vertical (boolean; defaults to false: upright columns right to left), size (text height as a fraction of the short edge, 0.005..0.5; default 0.035), opacity (0..1; default 0.7), anchor (topLeft|top|topRight|left|center|right|bottomLeft|bottom|bottomRight), insetX (margin from the left or right edge as a fraction of the short edge, 0..0.4; default 0.025), insetY (margin from the top or bottom edge, same units), inset (sets both), rotation (degrees clockwise: 0|90|180|270; default 0; the watermark is sized before it is turned), color [r,g,b] (sRGB 0..255), shadow (boolean), image (path of a graphic drawn instead of the text), imageWidth (fraction of the photo's width, 0.01..1; default 0.2)}. Unknown keys and out-of-range sizes are errors

width.description: Output width in px (with height: fit inside width × height, either orientation, unless `fit` says otherwise)

tools_pieni.description: Import Photos (command `library.import`). Params: {paths: [file or folder (recursive)], mode?: add|copy|move (add = reference the files in place; copy = into the library's Originals/YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD/; move = as copy, then each original and its XMP sidecars are removed from the source — only after the copy is verified (a hard link on the same volume, else copied, synced and compared byte for byte) and its catalog record is saved; failed, duplicate and unchecked files keep their sources; a taken name gets -1, -2…; undo removes the photos from the library but leaves the files at the destination), destination?: folder for copies / moves, organize?: date (YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD) | month (YYYY/YYYY-MM) | flat | a folder template, e.g. `{date:%Y}/{date:%Y%m%d}` → 2026/20260114 (the template's `/` make the folders, each level expanded with the rename tokens and made a safe folder name: never outside the destination; must be relative, no `..`; a level with missing metadata is `unknown`) — dated by capture time, else the import time, rename?: file-name template for copies, original extension added (tokens: {name} {num} {seq} {seq:N} {date} {date:%Y%m%d} {folder} {camera} {lens} {iso} {rating} {title} {creator} {ext}; photo.renameTokens explains each; blank = keep names), renameStart?: 1, metadataPreset?: name, dng?: bool (copy raws as DNG; copy only), local?: bool (browsing: the photos stay out of the library, like library.browse; not with move), album?: albumId, albumName?: new album, preset?: presetId, keywords?: [..], onDeleted?: restore|skip|fresh (a file that is in Recently Deleted: restore (default) = bring the photo back with its edits — relinked to the file when its own is gone, skip = leave it there and say so, fresh = delete the trashed record and import the file as new)} → {imported, duplicates: [{path, existing, reason, existingDeleted?}], restored?: [photoId], failed, warnings?: [{path, code: cameraProfile|uprightGeometry|unmappedXmp, profile?, mode?: off|auto|level|vertical|full|guided|unknown, fields?}], moved?: [{from, to, sidecars?}], kept?: [{path, reason}] (move: sources left in place and why), album?}. Menu: File. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+I.

tools_pieni.description: Run convert, ocr and/or optimize over files and folders, one file at a time. recursive defaults to false. Preserve paths relative to each selected folder inside out_dir; duplicate inputs run once. Skip unsupported files, links and the output subtree. Existing outputs receive numbered names and are never replaced. Continue after per-file errors unless stop_on_error is true. Return completed/failed/skipped counts and per-file results. Discovery is bounded to 10000 entries and 64 folder levels. Convert must be first; each step can appear once. OCR uses installed models. Optimize uses Reduce File Size settings, optionally overriding target ppi (threshold 1.5 times ppi) and JPEG quality; a larger candidate keeps the original bytes. Sources and open documents are unchanged.

Optional `endings` (two names: start, end) for a line, arrow or polyline, or one name for a callout: None, Square, Circle, Diamond, OpenArrow, ClosedArrow, Butt, ROpenArrow, RClosedArrow, Slash. tools_pieni.description: Replace the text of one paragraph (paragraph, from text_paragraphs: rewrapped to the paragraph's width with its line spacing) or one line (line, from text_lines) in place, keeping position, size and colour. For a mixed-style region, editor_text supplies visual row breaks; surviving text keeps its source-run styles and inserted text inherits the surrounding run. For a paragraph, also change its formatting: font (helvetica, times, courier) with bold/italic, size (points), color (#rrggbb), align (left, center, right, justify), underline, line_spacing (× size), char_spacing (points) and scale (horizontal, percent), or move it (dx, dy in points; up is +dy) and rewrap it to a new width (points); text may then be omitted. Its own font is reused when it can show every character and no font/weight change is requested; otherwise it uses a standard font matching the source style or, for text no standard font can show, real fallback outlines from PdfCraft's own faces, from the one that has every character: the craft-fonts Japanese faces (Mincho/Gothic matching the requested/source family and available weight) or, behind them, the bundled Inter face, which carries the Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters they lack (Uzbek қ, Kazakh ә). The result shows the font used, and for a paragraph its text unless the document's security doesn't allow copying. Missing Japanese weights use Regular, not synthetic bold; the small web build has only Gothic Regular. Paragraph bold may be set without font to keep the source family. Text that no available font can show is refused. A paragraph number is refused when an earlier edit merged that paragraph into a neighbour (list the page again); the result's stale_paragraphs names the numbers gone. Undoable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

dx.description: Paragraph only: move right by this many points (negative: left).

dy.description: Paragraph only: move up by this many points (negative: down).

font_resource.description: Explicit source/full page font resource from text_fonts or text_font_import.

line_spacing.description: Multiple of the font size (1.2 is ordinary).

ranges.description: Disjoint UTF-8 byte ranges in replacement text; unspecified source formatting survives.

width.description: Paragraph only: rewrap to this width in points (dragging the box's edge).

tools_pieni.description: Write an optimized copy to `path` (Acrobat's PDF Optimizer). preset: standard (default; Reduce File Size's choices) or mobile (images to 96 ppi above 144, JPEG high quality); the options below change it. merge_fragments (default true) first puts a page picture drawn as many stacked image strips (as some PDF printers write it) back together into one image, so it can be resampled (merged_images, fragments_merged). color / gray: { downsample, ppi, above_ppi, compression: jpeg|zip|retain, quality 1–100 } (defaults: downsample to 150 ppi above 225, JPEG 60). Images are measured where pages draw them and replaced only when smaller. discard_*: thumbnails (default true), alternate_images (true), tags, print_settings; flate_unencoded (true); remove_invalid_links and remove_unreferenced_dests (true); images and forms the pages list but never draw are always dropped (unused_xobjects). discard: Remove Hidden Information categories (metadata, attachments, comments, form-fields, hidden-text, hidden-layers, bookmarks, links-actions-scripts, private-data). Signed documents are refused. The open document is unchanged.

tools_pieni.name: command_batch
tools_pieni.title: Command batch
tools_pieni.description: Run several engine commands in one call, in order (fewer round trips). Returns {completed, failed, results:[{ok, result|error}]}; stops at the first error unless stop_on_error is false. Not an atomic transaction: earlier successful steps stay applied (no rollback).

steps.description:
Commands to run in order: `[{"id": "layer.new.layer", "params": {"name": "Ink"}}, …]`. A
step with `"wait": false` starts a long command as a background job (its result is
`{"job": id}`, as in `command_run`); later steps that edit the same document fail until
the job ends.

params.description: Command parameters as a JSON object (see the `params` doc in `command_list`).

wait.description:
Wait for a long command (filters, Content-Aware Fill, Photomerge, …) to finish (default
true). With false it runs as a background job and the result is `{"job": id}`: poll it
with `jobs_list`, stop it with `jobs_cancel`.

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true).

tools_pieni.name: command_list
tools_pieni.title: Command list
tools_pieni.description: List engine commands. Returns a JSON array (no wrapper object) of {id, label, menu: [path], shortcut: string|null, params: doc string, enabled: bool, disabledReason: string|null, needsDocument: bool}. `disabledReason` says why a command is off (null when enabled); `needsDocument` is true when it is off because no document is open: create or open one first (doc_new, doc_open).

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id, label or keywords contain this text (case-insensitive).

tools_pieni.name: command_run
tools_pieni.title: Command run
tools_pieni.description: Run an engine command by id with JSON params (see command_list). Returns the command's JSON result. Long commands (filters, Content-Aware Fill/Scale, Photomerge, brush import) wait to finish unless `wait` is false: then they run as a background job and the result is {job: id} (see jobs_list, jobs_cancel).

params.description: Command parameters as a JSON object (see the `params` doc in `command_list`).

wait.description:
Wait for a long command (filters, Content-Aware Fill, Photomerge, …) to finish (default
true). With false it runs as a background job and the result is `{"job": id}`: poll it
with `jobs_list`, stop it with `jobs_cancel`.

tools_pieni.name: control_call
tools_pieni.title: Control call
tools_pieni.description: Bridge mode: call any control-protocol method (docs/control-protocol.md) with raw params.

tools_pieni.name: doc_close
tools_pieni.title: Doc close
tools_pieni.description: Close a document (default: the active one) without saving.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

tools_pieni.name: doc_export
tools_pieni.title: Doc export
tools_pieni.description: Export the document to another format (same as doc_save with an explicit path/format).

ddsCompression.description:
DDS: "none" (uncompressed, the default), "bc1" (DXT1: alpha on or off), "bc2" (DXT3) or
"bc3" (DXT5).

ddsMipmaps.description: DDS: also write the full mip chain, each level a box filter of the one above.

dpxBits.description: DPX: 8, 10, 12 or 16 bits per sample. Unset: 8 for an 8-bit document, else 16.

format.description: Format override as an extension (pcraft, psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …).

path.description:
Target beneath the configured automation write root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.
The extension selects the format. Omit to write back to the document's own file, which
works only for a PSD, PSB or .pcraft file kept in its own format; any other save needs
`path`, so a flattened or converted copy never replaces the opened file.

quality.description: JPEG or WebP quality 1..100. A WebP saved with a quality is lossy; without one it is lossless.

tgaBits.description:
TGA: 24 or 32 bits per pixel. 32 writes the alpha channel (or else the transparency) as the
alpha, 24 none. Unset: 32 with an alpha channel or transparency, else 24.

tiffLayers.description: TIFF: keep the layers (Photoshop layer data). Off by default: a flat TIFF.

tools_pieni.name: doc_export_data_sets
tools_pieni.title: Doc export data sets
tools_pieni.description: Export every data set of the document as its own flattened file beneath the write root (the capability-scoped Export Data Sets). The batch is planned first, so colliding filenames are refused before any file is written.

data_sets.description: Only these data sets, by name; default every one of them.

dir.description: Directory beneath the configured automation write root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

tools_pieni.name: doc_export_layers
tools_pieni.title: Doc export layers
tools_pieni.description: Export each exported layer of the document as its own file beneath the write root (the capability-scoped Layers to Files). A file that already exists is an error, not an overwrite.

dir.description: Directory beneath the configured automation write root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

quality.description: Encoder quality, 0..12, for the formats that take one.

visible_only.description: Export only the layers that are visible (default true).

tools_pieni.name: doc_import_data_sets
tools_pieni.title: Doc import data sets
tools_pieni.description: Import a data set CSV from the read root into the document (the capability-scoped Import Variable Data Sets).

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

path.description: Path beneath the configured automation read root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

tools_pieni.name: doc_inspect
tools_pieni.title: Doc inspect
tools_pieni.description: Document state as JSON: layer tree (top to bottom), history, selection, active layer.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

tools_pieni.name: doc_new
tools_pieni.title: Doc new
tools_pieni.description: Create a new document (defaults: 1920x1080 RGB 8-bit white).

tools_pieni.name: doc_open
tools_pieni.title: Doc open
tools_pieni.description: Open an image or document file and make it active. Returns index, size and import warnings.

path.description: Path beneath the configured automation read root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

tools_pieni.name: doc_place
tools_pieni.title: Doc place
tools_pieni.description: Place a file into the document as a Smart Object layer (Place Embedded), reading `path` beneath the read root. `scale` (percent), `fit` and `center` are the command's own.

center.description: Centre of the placed layer, in document pixels.

fit.description: Place at a centred size instead of a scaled one.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

path.description: Path beneath the configured automation read root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

scale.description: Scale as a percentage; defaults to fitting a file larger than the canvas.

tools_pieni.name: doc_render_preview
tools_pieni.title: Doc render preview
tools_pieni.description: Render the flattened document and return it as a PNG image (bridge mode: window screenshot).

index.description:
Headless mode only: document index (default: the active document).
Bridge previews capture the app window and reject `index`.

max_side.description:
Longest side of a headless preview (default 1024, maximum 2048).
Zero requests full size within that ceiling. Bridge mode returns the window screenshot.

tools_pieni.name: doc_save
tools_pieni.title: Doc save
tools_pieni.description: Save the document. `.pcraft` is the lossless native format (incremental); other extensions (psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …) export. Without `path` only a PSD, PSB or .pcraft document is written back to its own         file. Returns warnings about anything the format cannot hold.

ddsCompression.description:
DDS: "none" (uncompressed, the default), "bc1" (DXT1: alpha on or off), "bc2" (DXT3) or
"bc3" (DXT5).

ddsMipmaps.description: DDS: also write the full mip chain, each level a box filter of the one above.

dpxBits.description: DPX: 8, 10, 12 or 16 bits per sample. Unset: 8 for an 8-bit document, else 16.

format.description: Format override as an extension (pcraft, psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …).

path.description:
Target beneath the configured automation write root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.
The extension selects the format. Omit to write back to the document's own file, which
works only for a PSD, PSB or .pcraft file kept in its own format; any other save needs
`path`, so a flattened or converted copy never replaces the opened file.

quality.description: JPEG or WebP quality 1..100. A WebP saved with a quality is lossy; without one it is lossless.

tgaBits.description:
TGA: 24 or 32 bits per pixel. 32 writes the alpha channel (or else the transparency) as the
alpha, 24 none. Unset: 32 with an alpha channel or transparency, else 24.

tiffLayers.description: TIFF: keep the layers (Photoshop layer data). Off by default: a flat TIFF.

tools_pieni.name: doc_select
tools_pieni.title: Doc select
tools_pieni.description: Make the document at `index` active.

tools_pieni.name: jobs_cancel
tools_pieni.title: Jobs cancel
tools_pieni.description: Cancel a background job by id (or every running job when `job` is omitted). The document is left unchanged.

job.description: The job id from `command_run` / `jobs_list` (omit to cancel every running job).

tools_pieni.name: jobs_list
tools_pieni.title: Jobs list
tools_pieni.description: List background jobs: running ones with progress (0-1), message and elapsed time, then the last few that ended (state done|failed|cancelled with their result or error). Finished jobs are applied first.

tools_pieni.name: render_preview
tools_pieni.title: Render preview
tools_pieni.description: Render a bounded flattened PNG preview (bridge mode: app window screenshot).

index.description:
Headless mode only: document index (default: the active document).
Bridge previews capture the app window and reject `index`.

max_side.description:
Longest side of a headless preview (default 1024, maximum 2048).
Zero requests full size within that ceiling. Bridge mode returns the window screenshot.

tools_pieni.name: session_list
tools_pieni.title: Session list
tools_pieni.description: List open documents (index, name, size, dirty) and the active index.

tools_pieni.name: ui_inspect
tools_pieni.title: Ui inspect
tools_pieni.description: Bridge mode: full UI state of the live app (tool, panels, views, dialogs, windows). For the menu tree, call `control_call` with method `ui.menu.list`.

tools_pieni.name: ui_menu_invoke
tools_pieni.title: Ui menu invoke
tools_pieni.description: Bridge mode: activate a menu item by id.

tools_pieni.name: ui_pointer
tools_pieni.title: Ui pointer
tools_pieni.description: Bridge mode: send pointer events (document coordinates) to the active tool; with a Color Picker open they sample the image into it instead.

button.description:
Mouse button: `left` (default), or `right` / `secondary`: with the Move tool or
`{"command":true}` it opens the canvas layer menu, with a painting tool the Brush Preset
picker.

items.description: One `ui_pointer` event, for the tool schema only: events are forwarded to `ui.pointer` as JSON.

tiltX.description: A simulated pen's tilt, as a stylus reports it.

tools_pieni.name: ui_screenshot
tools_pieni.title: Ui screenshot
tools_pieni.description: Bridge mode: screenshot of the live app window as PNG.

max_side.description:
Downscale the window screenshot to this longest side (maximum 2048).
Omit or pass zero to keep the original size.

tools_pieni.name: ui_set
tools_pieni.title: Ui set
tools_pieni.description: Bridge mode: change UI state (tool, panels, dock, zoom, center, fit, theme, brush settings; see `fields`). Unknown fields are an error.

fields.description:
Fields for the control method `ui.set`: tool, panels, dock, dockTabs, dockWidth, colorPanel
({background: bool} picks which swatch the Color panel edits), maskTarget,
vectorMaskTarget, selectionMode, zoom, center, rotation (view angle in degrees), fit, theme (pro, proMedium, studio,
studioLight, classic, solarizedDark, adwaita, adwaitaDark, breezeLight, breezeDark, softLight, softDark), brushSection, brushTab,
brushesView, brushPicker ([x, y] opens the Brush Preset picker there, null closes it),
brushPickerName, brushPickerStroke, brushPickerTip (the picker card's parts, at least one
on), brushPickerScale (the picker footer's card-scale slider, 0.15 to 2, 1 the standard),
brushSize, gradientBlendMode
(a blend mode name, for the Gradient tool), gradientClassic (bool), eyedropperSampleSize
("point" or 1, 3, 5, 11, 31, 51, 101), eyedropperSample (current, currentAndBelow, all,
allNoAdjustments, currentAndBelowNoAdjustments), eyedropperRing (bool), cropOverlay (thirds,
grid, diagonal, triangle, goldenRatio, goldenSpiral), cropOverlayShow (auto, always, never),
cropOverlayOrientation (0..3), cropShield (an object patching show_cropped_area, enabled,
color ("matchCanvas" or "custom"), custom_color ([r, g, b]), opacity (0..100),
auto_adjust, classic_mode and auto_center_preview), cropFill (background or contentAware,
the Crop tool's Fill), shapeStroke (an object patching width, align, cap, join, miterLimit,
dashes, dashOffset and opacity; null disables the stroke). Shape stroke fields use
`shape.edit` names and units; colour comes from `tools.setColors`. camTransformOnDrop (bool,
the Content-Aware Move tool's Transform On Drop). tileGrid (bool, a developer overlay of the
active layer's storage tiles). layerFilter (an object patching by ("kind", "name" or
"mode"), kinds (a list of layer kinds), name (matches part of the layer name) and mode (a
blend mode name) for the Layers panel filter). strokeTrace (true, false, "stderr" or "off":
the stroke latency trace at runtime; a CSV file is set at launch with --stroke-trace, not
over this channel). Other fields are an error.

tools_pieni.description: List SoundCraft commands (id, label, menu path, shortcut, params doc, enabled).
tools_pieni.name: list_commands

tools_pieni.description: Run one command by id with JSON params. Returns the command's result.
tools_pieni.name: execute

tools_pieni.description: Run up to 1000 commands in order; stops at the first error unless keep_going. Larger batches are rejected before any command runs.
tools_pieni.name: batch

tools_pieni.description: The whole session as JSON: tracks (clips, inserts, sends, automation), busses, markers, groups, selection, transport.
tools_pieni.name: inspect_session

tools_pieni.description: Start a new session (optionally the built-in demo).
tools_pieni.name: new_session

tools_pieni.description: Open a .scraft session file.
tools_pieni.name: open_session

tools_pieni.description: Save the session (path required the first time; replace: true to save over another existing file).
tools_pieni.name: save_session

tools_pieni.description: Import an audio file (WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, OGG, AAC/M4A, ALAC, CAF) onto a new or existing track.
tools_pieni.name: import_audio

tools_pieni.description: Render the mix to an audio file. Returns peak dBFS and integrated LUFS.
tools_pieni.name: bounce_mix

tools_pieni.description: Feature-parity report against the incumbent's menu catalog.
tools_pieni.name: parity

tools_pieni.description: APP_ONLY. Screenshot the app window (PNG).
tools_pieni.name: screenshot

tools_pieni.description: APP_ONLY. UI state: front window, panels, layout rectangles of tracks, dialogs.
tools_pieni.name: ui_inspect

tools_pieni.description: APP_ONLY. Set UI state fields, e.g. {"window": "Mix"}.
tools_pieni.name: ui_set

tools_pieni.description: APP_ONLY. Drag with the primary button.
tools_pieni.name: drag

tools_pieni.description: APP_ONLY. Press a key with modifiers.
tools_pieni.name: key

tools_pieni.description: Discover command ids, labels, parameter descriptions and enabled state. Returns an array. The whole catalogue is large: narrow it with filter (or query), menu, and brief.

brief.description: Leave out each command's params description (the bulk of the catalogue); run command_list with the id as filter to read it

filter.description: Case-insensitive id, label or menu substring

menu.description: Case-insensitive substring of the menu path, its levels joined with " > " (e.g. "Object", "Object > Path")

tools_pieni.description: Run steps in order; each edit is its own undo step, or with atomic:true the whole batch is one (named `label`, else after its first edit). A step's id is a command id, or draw_path / draw_shape with that tool's arguments as params (its result is the tool's: the new object's `id`). A param string that is exactly "$N.path" (N: 0-based step index) or "$last.path" takes that value from an earlier step's result, e.g. {"id":"$1.id"}; "$$" starts a literal "$". Returns completed, failed, results and created (the ids draw_path / draw_shape steps made, in order). Stops on the first error by default. At most 256 steps; kept step results total at most 8 MiB, past which the batch stops with the reason.

atomic.description: Make the batch's edits one undo step (needs an open document)

label.description: The undo step's name with atomic

limit.description: At most this many layers or nodes (the reply adds `total`)
