fill.description: Fill: "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

stroke.description: Stroke: "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

tools_pieni.name: set_paint
tools_pieni.title: Set paint

tools_pieni.description: Send a key press with modifiers, e.g. {key:"Z", mods:{cmd:true}} (undo), {key:"Escape"}, {key:"Enter"}. In the desktop app it goes through the real keyboard path; headless, it runs the command or tool bound to that shortcut.

key.description: Key name: A–Z, 0–9, Enter, Escape, Delete, Backspace, Tab, Space, Left/Right/Up/Down, [ ]…

mods.description: Modifier keys held (cmd = Command on macOS / Ctrl elsewhere; alt = Option)

tools_pieni.name: press_key
tools_pieni.title: Press key

tools_pieni.description: Type text into the focused widget (text tool, dialog field). Desktop app only.
tools_pieni.name: type_text
tools_pieni.title: Type text

tools_pieni.description: Invoke a menu item by its command id (same ids as list_commands, including UI-only commands like view.zoomIn or window.* in the desktop app).
tools_pieni.name: invoke_menu
tools_pieni.title: Invoke menu

tools_pieni.description: Open a panel in the desktop app's dock by id (layers, swatches, stroke, align, pathfinder, transform, …; case-insensitive, display labels like "Layers" work too). Desktop app only.
tools_pieni.name: open_panel
tools_pieni.title: Open panel

tools_pieni.description: Render the active artboard to PNG and return it as an image (optionally also saving it to `path`). With window:true (desktop app only) captures the whole app window instead.

path.description: Also write the PNG here

window.description: Capture the app window (desktop app only)

tools_pieni.name: screenshot
tools_pieni.title: Screenshot

tools_pieni.description: Open a file as a new, active document: .vectorcraft, .drawcraft, .svg, .svgz, .pdf, .ai, .ait, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp, .tif, .tiff, .bmp, .tga, .vda, .icb, .vst, .psd, .psb, .vctemplate, .dxf, .emf, .wmf, .eps, .epsf, .ps, .af, .afdesign, .afpub (see run_command document.formats). Templates (.ait, native templates) open as a new untitled document. The reply's `warnings` say what didn't come in as it was (an EPS shown as its preview image says why its PostScript couldn't be read).

path.description: File path

tools_pieni.name: open_file
tools_pieni.title: Open file

tools_pieni.description: Save the active document with the engine's document.save: by default to its own file in its own format (native .vectorcraft unless it was opened from or saved as SVG, PDF or a restorable .ai). With `path`, the extension picks the format: .vectorcraft, .vctemplate, .pdf, .svg, .svgz, .ai. Other formats are exports (see export). The reply's `format` says what was written and `warnings` what that format loses.

path.description: Destination; its extension picks the format (default: the document's own file)

tools_pieni.name: save_file
tools_pieni.title: Save file

tools_pieni.description: Export the active document with the engine's document.export (the same bytes in the app and headless), in any format of the `format` enum: vectors (svg/svgz with the artboard as viewBox, eps, dxf, emf, wmf), pdf and ai (one page per artboard: all, or `artboard` / `range`; ai is the PDF-compatible .ai file that Save writes, which carries the document when every artboard is written in order), rasters (one rendered artboard: png, jpg, webp, gif, png8 as an indexed .png, tiff, bmp, tga, psd with its layers), txt (the stories, back to front), vectorcraft or template (a native copy or template; the document keeps its path). run_command document.formats lists each format's options. For SVG/SVGZ, top-level `outlineText: true` writes text as paths; DXF takes it too (its type is outlined anyway unless `preserve: editability`). PDF instead uses `options.advanced.outlineText: true`, default false (live text). `selection: true` exports only the selected objects, cropped to their bounds. Template layers are left out; live effects are kept (geometry baked, SVG filters for shadows/glows/blur). Without `path` the bytes come back as dataBase64.

artboard.description: 0-based artboard (default: the first; PDF and .ai default: all)

options.description: More format options, passed through (see run_command document.formats), e.g. {"quality": 80} for jpg or {"advanced": {"outlineText": true}} for PDF text as outlines (default false: live text)

outlineText.description: SVG/SVGZ: true writes text as outlines (viewable without the fonts). DXF takes it too (type outlined anyway unless preserve: editability). PDF uses options.advanced.outlineText instead (default false: live text)

path.description: Destination file (omit to get dataBase64)

range.description: 1-based artboards such as "1-3, 5" (PDF and .ai: one page each; SVG, SVGZ and EPS: one file each; rasters, DXF, EMF and WMF: one, or one file each with options.useArtboards: true)

selection.description: Export only the selection, cropped to it

tools_pieni.name: export
tools_pieni.title: Export

tools_pieni.description: Create point type at (x, y) (the first baseline), area type when width/height are given (`fit` autoHeight grows the frame to the text, shrinkText scales the text down to fit), or type in/on an existing path (`path` id + `mode` area|onPath; `pathEffect` rainbow|skew|3dRibbon|stairStep|gravity). Returns the text object id, with `overflow: true` when the text doesn't fit its frame or path (the lines past it aren't drawn: enlarge the frame, shrink the text or give `fit`).

color.description: Text colour (#rrggbb): "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

fit.description: Area type: keep the frame (none), fit its height to the text (autoHeight) or scale overflowing text down (shrinkText)

fitMinPercent.description: shrinkText: the smallest scale in percent, 10 to 100 (default 50)

justify.description: Paragraph alignment (default auto: the start of the text's direction). Point type lines up on x: center centres each line on it, right ends it there

path.description: Existing path id to flow the text in (area) or along (onPath)

vertical.description: Vertical writing for point, area or path type (default false, horizontal), as text.create / text.createInPath

x.description: Baseline origin x (area type: left; point type: where the line starts, or its centre or end with justify center/right)

tools_pieni.name: add_text
tools_pieni.title: Add text

tools_pieni.description: Append a live effect (Effect menu) to the selection or `ids`. Omit `effect` to get the catalogue (ids, parameters, defaults). Examples: stylize.dropShadow {x, y, blur, opacity}, distort.roughen, warp.arc {bend}, path.offsetPath {offset}, pathfinder.add (on groups), blur.gaussian {radius}.

params.description: Effect parameters; missing keys take the dialog defaults

tools_pieni.name: apply_effect
tools_pieni.title: Apply live effect

tools_pieni.description: Combine the selected (or `ids`) objects destructively, back to front: unite, minusFront, intersect, exclude, divide, trim, merge, crop, outline, minusBack. For a non-destructive version apply the pathfinder.* effect to a group.
tools_pieni.name: pathfinder
tools_pieni.title: Pathfinder

tools_pieni.description: Move, rotate, scale, reflect or shear the selection (or `ids`); several may be combined and run in that order. Angles in degrees (counter-clockwise), scale in %. `origin` [x,y] defaults to the selection centre; `copy` transforms a copy.
tools_pieni.name: transform
tools_pieni.title: Transform

tools_pieni.description: Create a graph (graph tools) in the plot rectangle. Data as `csv` (first row: empty cell then series names; then one row per category: label, values…) or `series`/`categories`/`rows`. An empty CSV cell or a null in `rows` is a blank value (no column; lines break around it); a number in straight quotes is a label. Edit later with run_command graph.setData / graph.setType.
tools_pieni.name: create_graph
tools_pieni.title: Create graph

tools_pieni.description: Make the selected (or `ids`) objects wrap objects: area type below them in the same layer flows around them (offset in pt, invert = flow inside). `release: true` removes the wrap.

offset.description: Gap between text and object (default 6 pt)

tools_pieni.name: text_wrap
tools_pieni.title: Text wrap

tools_pieni.description: Undo the last change (Edit → Undo).
tools_pieni.name: undo
tools_pieni.title: Undo

tools_pieni.description: Redo the last undone change (Edit → Redo).
